title: Buy Now, Pay Later Debt in 2026: What Happens When the Bill Finally Comes Due | Keenan Law
summary: Bankruptcy attorney's blog post on BNPL debt accumulation, collections risk, and bankruptcy discharge of BNPL balances.

assertions.quote: a consumer with six open BNPL plans is not managing one debt, they are managing six separate payment streams
longer-term installment financing that carries real interest, often between 15 and 36 percent annually
BNPL balances are discharged along with credit cards, personal loans and other general unsecured debt

verdicts.note: Under U.S. bankruptcy law, general unsecured debts including BNPL balances are dischargeable in Chapter 7 absent fraud.

assertions.quote: on-time payments built no credit record. Missed payments and charge-offs could still end up on credit reports
the pay-in-four model...involves fewer than five scheduled payments, which historically allowed it to avoid certain TILA disclosure mandates

verdicts.note: The pay-in-four structure's fewer-than-five-payments design has historically let it fall outside some TILA disclosure triggers.

CFPB's own analysis finds 'some market participants' offerings appear to be structured to evade certain federal consumer lending requirements,' specifically that most BNPL lenders don't provide the standardized cost-of-credit disclosures Regulation Z requires of comparable credit products.

assertions.quote: judgment creditors can execute against bank accounts through a levy process that can freeze and seize funds

verdicts.note: This is the standard legal process for an unpaid, charged-off debt once a creditor sues and wins a judgment.
